task: P6 Morphine SBI TDM bias investigation
root_cause: Parameter non-identifiability: IS and SBI find DIFFERENT posterior modes in theta-space that both plausibly explain the observation. IS locks onto low-CL/low-abs mode (peff=1.99, enzyme_aff=1.08); SBI spans high-CL/high-abs mode (peff=2.57, enzyme_aff=2.60). SBC passes because marginal theta coverage is correct; individual-patient identifiability is not guaranteed by SBC.
bias_mechanism: SBI posterior is wide (CV 47% vs prior 41%, barely tightened). Forward-simulating a wide theta distribution produces a lognormal-like Cmax distribution. Mean of such a distribution is biased upward relative to observation (and relative to median). This is a point-estimator choice issue, not a coverage issue.
code_location: src/sisyphus/regimen/tdm_sbi.py:628 — `post_mean = float(np.mean(post_arr))`. Posterior point estimate uses arithmetic mean; median would be less biased for skewed distributions.

proposed_fixes_pending_approval.name: median point estimate
proposed_fixes_pending_approval.change: Return posterior_cmax.mean = np.median(post_arr) instead of mean, OR add posterior_cmax_median field
proposed_fixes_pending_approval.risk: Affects all 11 SBI-routed drugs; needs re-running TDM tournament; may change routing decisions
proposed_fixes_pending_approval.estimated_impact: Morphine bias should drop from +52% to <20% (posterior median ≈ 0.021 based on CV 47% skew)

proposed_fixes_pending_approval.name: likelihood reweighting on SBI posterior
proposed_fixes_pending_approval.change: After SBI draws N samples, apply physical Gaussian likelihood to re-weight. Same mechanism as IS but using SBI proposals instead of prior.
proposed_fixes_pending_approval.risk: Loses SBI amortization speed advantage partially; needs new test coverage
proposed_fixes_pending_approval.estimated_impact: Morphine bias should approach IS bias (+3%) at 2-5x wall-time increase

proposed_fixes_pending_approval.name: keep current IS override
proposed_fixes_pending_approval.change: No code change; production routes morphine→IS via method_routing.json

recommendation: Option 3 (status quo) is safest. IS override working correctly. Median fix (Option 1) is principled and low-code-risk but requires validation across all SBI drugs. Reweighting (Option 2) defeats amortization purpose for this case.
production_status: morphine routes to IS in data/sbi/method_routing.json (v2), no regression
